1  medium  The macOS application firewall is disabled (macos) [fw.app_firewall_disabled]
   Observed      fw.global#1 (07:12, as deploy): Firewall is disabled. (State = 0)
   Severity      medium
   Why here      scheck was not told how this machine is used (for example, whether it faces the
                 internet), so this is the standard rating.
   Fix           Turn the application firewall on in System Settings > Network > Firewall, or from
                 the command line.
                 Caveat: This is a per-application filter, not a packet filter; it does not replace
                   a network firewall.
                 Commands (review before running):
                   sudo /usr/libexec/ApplicationFirewall/socketfilterfw --setglobalstate on

2  low  Software updates are pending (macos) [updates.pending]
   Observed      pkg.softwareupdate#1 (07:12, as deploy): name=Safari27.0TahoeAuto-27.0 version=27.0
                 (+2 more)
   Severity      low
   Why here      scheck was not told how this machine is used (for example, whether it faces the
                 internet), so this is the standard rating.
   Fix           Review the pending updates and apply them with the host's package manager.
                 Caveat: Some updates need a restart to take effect; schedule accordingly.
                 Commands (review before running):
                   # review the list first, then apply with apt / dnf / zypper / softwareupdate

IF YOU DECIDE NOT TO FIX A FINDING
Only for a risk you decide not to fix, and decided by whoever owns it: write the engagement to a
file (--write-engagement FILE), add yourself under people, paste the entry under
intent.accepted_risks in that file and write the reason, then run `scheck run FILE` from then on.
